validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline existence confirmed via PR Newswire FID announcement (7/31/2024), official website (blackcombpipeline.com), EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects (Aug 2026 release), and Texas RRC permit T4-10643. Ownership structure: WPC Joint Venture (70% WhiteWater/MPLX/Enbridge), Targa Resources (17.5%), MPLX (12.5%). Supply from Permian Basin (Midland and Delaware basins). Destination: Agua Dulce area, South Texas, providing LNG export access. FID announcement indicates target in-service date 'second half of 2026', EIA update notes in-service pushed back from July 2026 to November 2026. No evidence of status change from construction to operating as of September 2026.
